title: Clean Up Resources with onUnmounted
short_description: Practice starting external effects when a component mounts and cleaning them up when it unmounts.
description: In this challenge, you will complete a session monitor that activates when the component appears on screen.
The goal is to use onMounted to start an interval and listen for resize changes, and onUnmounted to clean up those external resources.
instructions: Import onMounted and onUnmounted from vue.
Use onMounted to run startSession when the component mounts.
Inside startSession, change isSessionActive to true, update viewportWidth, and register the resize listener.
Start an interval that increases secondsOnline every second.
Use onUnmounted to run stopSession and clean up both the interval and the resize listener.

hints.title: Import the hooks
hints.body: The import can include ref, onMounted, and onUnmounted: import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue".

hints.title: Initialize from onMounted
hints.body: Do not call startSession at the top level of setup. Register it with onMounted(startSession) so it runs once the component is mounted.

hints.title: Clean up external work
hints.body: Vue does not clean up setInterval or window.addEventListener for you. Use clearInterval and removeEventListener inside stopSession.
